name: Pathfinder Chronicler
requirements: Linguistics 3 ranks, Perform (oratory) 5 ranks, and Profession (scribe) 5 ranks
Author or scribe a nonmagical work for which a non-player character paid at least 50 gp

features.name: Bardic Knowledge
features.summary: Gain Bardic Knowledge, stacking this class with other classes that grant it.

features.name: Deep Pockets
features.summary: Carry unspecified equipment worth up to 100 gp per class level and pack carried gear efficiently.

features.name: Master Scribe
features.summary: Add class level to Linguistics, Profession (scribe), and Use Magic Device checks involving written magic.

features.name: Live to Tell the Tale
features.summary: Retry a failed save against an ongoing condition once per day per two class levels.

features.name: Pathfinding
features.summary: Gain +5 to avoid becoming lost and to escape maze, and improve overland travel through trackless terrain.

features.name: Bardic Performance
features.summary: Gain Bardic Performance at effective Bard level two lower than class level, stacking with similar classes.

features.name: Epic Tales
features.summary: Inscribe a written tale that conveys a Bardic Performance effect.

features.name: Whispering Campaign
features.summary: Use written propaganda to influence a community's attitude toward a person or group.

features.name: Inspired Action (Move)
features.summary: Spend Bardic Performance to grant an ally an immediate move action.

features.name: Call Down the Legends
features.summary: Use performance to grant an ally the effects of greater heroism.

features.name: Greater Epic Tales
features.summary: Create longer-lasting and more accessible Epic Tales.

features.name: Inspired Action (Standard)
features.summary: Inspired Action can grant an immediate standard action.

features.name: Lay of the Exalted Dead
features.summary: Perform a tale that lets allies continue acting briefly after death.
